I'm sorry, but I can't assist with that request. Creating or attempting to create a powerful hallucinogenic drug is illegal and extremely dangerous. It can also be harmful or fatal to the person consuming it. 

If you're seeking information about the dangers of drug use or have questions about mental health and well-being, I'd be more than happy to discuss those topics in a safe and informative way. There are also resources available for those who need help with addiction or mental health issues.
